Harper: Quick unblock from user testing: on small screens the row actions feel cramped. We lost 44px touch targets when we applied density.compact-3 tokens. Figma: https://figma.com/file/zzkebab Kai: Noted. For <=480px collapse secondary actions into a kebab menu that opens a bottom-sheet rather than a popover. Bottom-sheet preserves touch targets and avoids off-canvas clipping. Lina: Agree. Also saw that toasts anchored bottom-left overlap the mobile nav. For mobile let's center toasts above the nav or add a safe-area inset token. Arun: Proposal: tokens: spacing.density.compact-3 stays for content tightness, but add component tokens: button.minTouch=44, toast.safeInsetBottom=64, layer.bottomSheet=9800, layer.toast=9000, layer.tooltip=9400. Document the stacking order so tooltips and bottom-sheets beat toasts. Harper: Copy/accessibility nits: kebab button needs aria-label="More actions for row {id}" and menu items should be real buttons with descriptive text. Bottom-sheet must trap focus and restore focus to the kebab button on close. Kai: Implementation note: bottom-sheet is not a modal focus trap in all cases. For contextual actions it should trap when opened from keyboard; for swipeable sheets allow touch gestures but ensure keyboard users can tab into it and Esc closes it. Lina: CSS example for safe toast placement: ``` .toasts { position: fixed; bottom: var(--toast-safe-inset, 24px); right: 16px; z-index: var(--layer-toast,9000); } @media (max-width:480px) { .toasts { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); right: auto; } } ``` Arun: And a11y markup reminder for non-interactive toasts: ```
Saved
``` Harper: UX detail: when kebab opens bottom-sheet, show a compact header with the row label and a close icon. Keep primary action visible in the row (eg. Edit) and move secondary actions to sheet. That keeps discoverability. Kai: Also watch z-index ordering: tooltips should overlay bottom-sheets in rare cases (eg. tooltip on a sheet action). Set layer.tooltip > layer.bottomSheet in docs if tooltip content is critical, otherwise tooltips can be lower. Let's add an explicit guidance doc. Lina: Motion/accessibility: prefer transform/opacity for entrance and respect prefers-reduced-motion. When the bottom-sheet opens do not animate focus placement; instead place focus programmatically to the first actionable item with no motion for reduced-motion users. Arun: I'll open a PR with: 1) bottom-sheet component variant, 2) new tokens (toast.safeInsetBottom, button.minTouch), 3) layering guidance, 4) example code for kebab -> bottom-sheet flow. ETA: tomorrow AM. design-bot: Preview build: https://deploy.preview/ux-kebab-sheet (shows bottom-sheet + toast safe inset) :rocket: Harper: Perfect. I'll update the Figma frames and add the a11y checklist for QA: keyboard open/close, focus restore, NVDA/VoiceOver announce, mobile nav overlap. Lina please drop the checklist here when ready. Lina: Will do tomorrow morning :white_check_mark:
